text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each row is the first arm minus the second on the quantile score over all leads; below zero favours the first arm. 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026, ENS weather. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.375% interval (Bonferroni across the eight planned contrasts) from re-drawing whole months and seeds.'
